risks.note: The Company operates in a highly competitive lubricant market where fluctuation in raw material prices and changes in demand patterns can influence profitability, and economic downturns may dampen industrial activity and reduce lubricant consumption. Mitigated through index-based term contracts for crude procurement, supplier performance reviews, monitoring of competitor pricing, OEM movements and vehicle parc data, and a strong distribution network.
risks.risk: Industry risk - competitive intensity and raw-material price fluctuation

risks.note: Inadequate or unsuccessful R&D can limit the ability to innovate and meet shifting market requirements, resulting in loss of competitiveness and market share. Mitigated by tracking API, ACEA and JASO category announcements, working with top additive manufacturers and maintaining OEM dialogue.

The lubricant industry keeps advancing production and quality-control systems; failure to upgrade promptly may lead to operational inefficiencies, higher production costs and impact on product quality and competitiveness.
risks.risk: Technology risk - failure to upgrade production and quality-control infrastructure

risks.note: Distributor and customer default, which may rise in an economic slowdown, affects cash flow. Managed through strict working-capital oversight, monthly sales and operations planning, analytical tools, internal funds and bank credit lines, and periodic review of internal financial controls.
risks.risk: Credit risk on distributors and customers

risks.note: Excess stock can become obsolete as demand shifts, locking up working capital and raising storage costs. Managed through frequent stock checks, internal audits, alignment of inventory with production and delivery schedules and regular rebalancing of slow or non-moving stock.
risks.risk: Inventory risk - obsolescence and working-capital lock-up

risks.note: Currency movements influence both raw-material cost and realisation from export revenues, affecting overall financial performance; the Company monitors exposure and deploys hedging mechanisms where necessary.
risks.risk: Foreign exchange risk from multi-geography operations

risks.note: Cyberattacks may lead to data breaches, system intrusions and disruption to business operations. Addressed via endpoint security and hardware firewalls across all operational locations, annual cybersecurity and VAPT audits, daily monitoring, and employee phishing simulation drills; cyber security is specifically covered by the Board-adopted Risk Management Plan.
risks.risk: Cyber security and data privacy risk

risks.note: Identified in the BRSR material-issues table as a risk with negative financial implications; mitigation is adoption of renewable energy, energy-efficiency improvement, environmental risk mapping and planned ESG advisory to build climate resilience into operations.
risks.risk: Climate change - regulatory, operational and reputational exposure
